limits: Targets are research hypotheses, not published or identified promotion cutoffs
Frozen lookup bot, not an agent reading the Skill
Independent unseeded histories, not cloned state counterfactuals
Changing a priority can alter later states, warnings and choices
Do not infer that a single observed final action caused a review failure
Technical interruptions stay unknown, never coded as failure
All contrasts and secondary intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons
Post-treatment survivor categories describe where paths stall, not conditional causal effects
